initial_pre_execution_analysis.conditional_statement: If the clean patch has strict diagonal row-cosine maxima versus public base, every global residual permutation is inverted by the same public matching rule, independent of how the permutation was chosen.
initial_pre_execution_analysis.limitation: The old MNIST control and current transformation audit imply the family-level consequence for MNIST; direct execution on the current three releases remains pending. No DTD/SVHN diagonal-margin evidence is inferred.

followup_after_actual_recovery.proof_scope: For these frozen original/public pairs, every pure common residual permutation satisfies the diagonal-row matching condition, independently of the task objective. This is not impossibility for other defense families.

orthogonal_input_condition.inputs: Same frozen three releases and public base; clean target only for matched-control and posthoc comparison, never in published-only alignment call.
orthogonal_input_condition.condition: For Xq=QX and Q orthogonal, Cq=B Xq^T=C Q^T. If C nonsingular, polar(Cq)=polar(C) Q^T, hence aligned input equals matched untreated input for every Q.
orthogonal_input_condition.selection: No new Q,rank,angle,seed,release,images or partner. Apply fixed official SVD kernel once to each actual frozen release and its matched untreated input operator; independent NumPy SVD.
orthogonal_input_condition.scope: Input operator only, not complete GLMC reproduction. No global-rotation CLIP implementation or whole-network recovery accuracy is asserted. Do not assume arbitrary rotations commute with native ln_pre.
orthogonal_input_condition.failure_policy: Preserve failed rank or tolerance condition; no changing thresholds,retries or new candidate.
